name: use-inbox
title: useInbox, useConversation, useInboxWidget
description: useInbox, useConversation and useInboxWidget: the inbox block's controllers as React hooks, for React DOM and React Native.
docs: Needs the inbox block (`npx better-supabase add inbox`), `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and a `BetterSupabaseProvider` above the component. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/inbox.
